a.xlink:title: Returns the canonical log token for a boundary-face enum value.
Assembles one cell's six outward face planes from the shared per-face planes.
Opens a family's face-plane arrays for reading; MetricComputeFacePlanes() must have run.
Updates a particle's interpolation weights based on distances to cell faces.
Signed distance from p to a face plane, positive on the cell side, zeroed below threshold.
Index of point (i, j, k) in a block's ghosted local arrays (coordinates, lCent, planes).
Builds the six face planes of a hexahedron, as the particle search tests them.
A function that outputs the name of the current level in the ParticleLocation enum.
